column2: Yeah.{wait}{clear}I thought you might be fed up with how ugly this world is.{wait}{clear}
That's... not true...{wait}{clear}I... intend to fight alongside you to the end. I have no intention of running away.{wait}{clear}

Sorry. That was rude of me. I apologize.{wait}{clear}Honestly, I didn't understand you. I thought maybe, as an angel, you were just passing the Heavens' orders on to us...{wait}{clear}I'm glad we could talk like this. Now I know how you think.{wait}{clear}Let's fight together... from here on, too.{wait}{clear}
No... I don't ask myself whether this world is worth saving...{wait}{clear}That isn't mine to judge.{wait}{clear}

I see... I don't know what you think of this world, but to me, it's a world I can't replace.{wait}{clear}I believe I have to protect it.{wait}{clear}＄＄＄＄＄＄, let's keep working together and fight side by side.{wait}{clear}
Yes, a little...{wait}{clear}
I see.{wait}{clear}
I'll listen, if I'm any use...{wait}{clear}
About the heroes...{n}
The cause of the world's turmoil...{n}
There's something about the heroes that's on my mind. Or rather... I'm worried whether I really understand them...{wait}{clear}
I see... So even you worry about whether you can understand people.{wait}{clear}But is that something you think about so your work goes smoothly? Or...{wait}{clear}
It's true that people may think I, an angel, only try to understand them for the sake of my mission...{wait}{clear}But that isn't all.{wait}{clear}
That isn't all?{wait}{clear}

No. When they're troubled, or when they're suffering, I want to do whatever I can.{wait}{clear}But if we can't trust each other, I don't think I can be any help at all...{wait}{clear}So...{wait}{clear}
I see... Maybe it's only natural to worry about that.{wait}{clear}
So that's how it is, after all?{wait}{clear}

Yeah. Understanding each other isn't something that happens overnight.{wait}{clear}It isn't easy even between humans. And you're an angel...{wait}{clear}However long you're with us, I think it can't be helped if we feel we don't know what you're thinking.{wait}{clear}
I suppose... that's true...{wait}{clear}
But I think your wish to understand us will surely get through...{wait}{clear}Talking like this, I feel you're someone I can trust...{wait}{clear}
Thank you, Fein.{wait}{clear}
Don't rush it. People have many sides. What you can see isn't always all there is.{wait}{clear}
Yes, you're right... I'll try not to lose heart, even if I make a few mistakes.{wait}{clear}
Ha ha ha... That's the spirit.{wait}{clear}
I'm concerned about the cause of the world's turmoil. I feel something terrible is lurking deep beneath what we can see now.{wait}{clear}But I can't tell what it is...{wait}{clear}

When I look at the world with you like this, all I notice is how foolish we humans are... The strong oppress the weak...{wait}{clear}But you're thinking of some other cause, beyond the turmoil we can see.{wait}{clear}

Yes. I think people do give in to all sorts of desires. But that is only a result they choose.{wait}{clear}But if those desires were brought about by something other than people... that would be truly terrible.{wait}{clear}

I see...{wait}{clear}Maybe I should look at what's happening now from a different angle, too...{wait}{clear}Thank you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. If I hadn't talked with you, I might have been caught up in nothing but the turmoil in front of me.{wait}{clear}
